request.style: English, female vocal, warm and reflective, solo with piano and strings, hopeful yet solemn, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What can be known is plain to see
God has made the truth so clear
Since the world began to be
The invisible are fully near

[Chorus]
His invisible qualities shown
Eternal power and divine nature
From what he made we know
His glory shines without a measure

[Verse]
Though they knew him, they did not praise
They gave no thanks to God
Their thinking became futile days
Their senseless hearts were darkened, cold

[Chorus]
His invisible qualities shown
Eternal power and divine nature
From what he made we know
His glory shines without a measure

[Bridge]
Claiming wisdom, they became fools
Exchanged glory for the dead
Images of mortal things
Where the living God instead

[Chorus]
His invisible qualities shown
Eternal power and divine nature
From what he made we know
His glory shines without a measure

[Outro]
So they are without excuse
The invisible are clearly seen
